subject: English
question_text: Read the following sentences and put them in correct order.
stimulus: (a) But the guests praised Hatem Tai also. This made the king angry. (b) Long ago there lived a very kind and generous man in Yemen. (c) The name of that man was Hatem Tai. (d) People praised him more than their king. (e) He was not rich but he was very hospitable. (f) So, the king felt happy and proud. (g) One day the king gave a dinner. The guests praised the king. (h) So, the king wanted to have him removed from the world.
guide_solution: b → c →e → d → g → f → a →h
